test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_countmin_large_dictionary_src( c1 UInt64, c2 UInt32, c3 LowCardinality(UInt32)) ENGINE = Memory;
CREATE TABLE t_countmin_large_dictionary_regular_none( c1 UInt64, c2 UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_large_dictionary_low_cardinality_none( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(UInt32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_large_dictionary_regular_countmin( c1 UInt64, c2 UInt32 STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_large_dictionary_low_cardinality_countmin( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(UInt32) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_countmin_large_dictionary_src WITH toUInt32(multiIf(number < 900000, number, number % 10 < 6, 42, number % 10 < 9, 7, 899999)) AS value SELECT number, value, CAST(value, 'LowCardinality(UInt32)') FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 1000000, max_threads = 1
test.query: INSERT INTO t_countmin_large_dictionary_regular_none SELECT c1 - 900000, c2 FROM t_countmin_large_dictionary_src WHERE c1 >= 900000 SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
